results.title: Surviving crisis: Building tourism entrepreneurial resilience as a ...
results.content: Research on gender-related challenges within tourism entrepreneurship is expanding; however, scant attention has been paid to how women entrepreneurs build resilience during sustained periods of politico-economic crisis. Using a multi-/interdisciplinary approach and informed by diverse disciplinary perspectives, his research stems from an interest in geography of tourism and, more particularly, critical tourism geographies, impacts of tourism, resilience, sustainability and politics of tourism and peace through tourism. **Albert Nsom Kimbu**, PhD is a Reader in the School of Hospitality and Tourism Management, University of Surrey (UK), and Senior Research Associate at the School of Tourism and Hospitality, University of Johannesburg (South Africa). He researches entrepreneurship, gender, equity and diversity in tourism for inclusive development. **Masoomeh Tavangar**, PhD is the Head of the Department of Tourism Management at the ACECR Institute of Tourism Research in Mashhad, Iran. Her research interests focus on tourism management and development with a particular emphasis on Iran. His main research interests include technology adoption, digital transformation, digitalization of services, AI, Big Data, travel, tourism & hospitality management.
